verdict.rationale: DeepSeek documents that legacy aliases (deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner) map to specific underlying modes and gives advance discontinuation notice, showing some alias-to-version awareness, but there's no documented scheme for pinning an exact immutable versioned model ID distinct from a rolling alias. missing for 10: explicit versioned model ID naming convention, documentation of how aliases update to new versions over time, and confirmation that pinned IDs remain stable/available after alias updates.
